notes.title: July 2025 update
notes.notes:
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWS_B7HHLJo"][/dynamiclink]

Hey everyone, it’s been a while! Big thanks to everyone who shared feedback! I’ve listened and made changes:

Major UI overhaul for barter, inventory, and dialogue

Less intrusive cursor that fades after the first click

Combat tiles now show reachable areas, not just individual squares. Green areas highlight the area where you will still have enough action points to attack after moving

Trailer and screenshots have been refreshed too!



As always, I’d love to hear your thoughts and I’m all ears for more feedback.
